scenarios.title: A｜当场澄清
scenarios.setting: 会议中发现项目出现错误，同事突然暗示是玩家造成的。

turns.text: I think the problem happened because Alex sent us the wrong version of the file.

turns.prompt: 关于「同事把错误推给自己」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: Actually, I’d like to clarify that. The file I sent was the correct version.

feedback.naturalExpression: Actually, I’d like to clarify that. The file I sent was the correct version.
feedback.explanation: “version”指版本，说明具体版本能避免双方使用不同文件。

choices.text: I don’t think that’s what happened. Let me explain.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t think that’s what happened. Let me explain.
feedback.explanation: “I don’t think”把不同意见表达为自己的判断，而不是直接断定对方错误。

choices.text: Just to be clear, I sent the updated file on Tuesday afternoon.

feedback.naturalExpression: Just to be clear, I sent the updated file on Tuesday afternoon.
feedback.explanation: 提供自己经历或做过的具体情况，让对方能在已知信息上继续确认。

choices.text: I think we should check the timeline before we decide what caused the problem.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think we should check the timeline before we decide what caused the problem.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: That’s not my fault. You’re the one who made the mistake.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Actually, I’d like to clarify that. The file I sent was the correct version.
feedback.explanation: 连续用“not my fault / you”互相归责，容易偏离解决问题；先核对流程和记录更有效。

turns.text: Do we know which version was actually used?

turns.prompt: 你想提供文件版本信息，澄清经过，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yes. The file I sent was version 4.2, but the older 4.1 file was used later.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. The file I sent was version 4.2, but the older 4.1 file was used later.
feedback.explanation: “version”指版本，说明具体版本能避免双方使用不同文件。

choices.text: I can pull up the message where I sent the updated version.

feedback.naturalExpression: I can pull up the message where I sent the updated version.
feedback.explanation: “version”指版本，说明具体版本能避免双方使用不同文件。

choices.text: Let me share my screen. I still have the original message.

feedback.naturalExpression: Let me share my screen. I still have the original message.
feedback.explanation: “original”指原件或原始版本；与复印件、修改版区分。

choices.text: I think we can confirm it from the file history.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think we can confirm it from the file history.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

turns.text: Okay, let’s check that before we go any further.

turns.prompt: 你想说出自己的偏好或顾虑，会怎么表达？

choices.text: Agreed. I’d rather make sure we have the facts first.

feedback.naturalExpression: Agreed. I’d rather make sure we have the facts first.
feedback.explanation: “make sure”表示核实、确认，能说明重复提问是为避免理解出错。

choices.text: Sounds good.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sounds good.
feedback.explanation: 明确表示接受刚提出的方案，让对方知道可以按这个安排继续。

scenarios.title: B｜私下沟通
scenarios.setting: 会议结束后，玩家找到刚刚把责任推给自己的同事。

turns.prompt: 你想找同事聊清楚之前会议上的说法，会怎么说？

choices.text: Can we talk about what you said in the meeting earlier?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can we talk about what you said in the meeting earlier?
feedback.explanation: 用问句确认自己能否这样做，既说明所需动作，也让对方有机会解释限制。

choices.text: I wanted to clear something up about the mistake we discussed.

feedback.naturalExpression: I wanted to clear something up about the mistake we discussed.
feedback.explanation: “clear something up”表示澄清误会或不明之处，是解释事情前常见的开场。

choices.text: I was uncomfortable with the way the issue was presented in the meeting.

feedback.naturalExpression: I was uncomfortable with the way the issue was presented in the meeting.
feedback.explanation: “uncomfortable”指不舒服或不自在，描述的是自己的感受。

choices.text: I don’t think it was fair to suggest that the mistake was mine without checking first.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t think it was fair to suggest that the mistake was mine without checking first.
feedback.explanation: “I don’t think”把不同意见表达为自己的判断，而不是直接断定对方错误。

turns.text: I wasn’t blaming you. I was just saying the wrong file came from your side.

turns.prompt: 你想纠正对方对文件来源的说法，会怎么说？

choices.text: But that’s not accurate. I sent the correct file.

feedback.naturalExpression: But that’s not accurate. I sent the correct file.
feedback.explanation: 转折后的内容说明当前需要注意的不同情况，能把顾虑或限制说清楚。

choices.text: I understand, but saying that in front of everyone made it sound like I caused the problem.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand, but saying that in front of everyone made it sound like I caused the problem.
feedback.explanation: “I understand”承认听懂了对方的理由或难处，为继续协商提供基础。

choices.text: If you’re unsure about something I did, I’d appreciate it if you checked with me first.

feedback.naturalExpression: If you’re unsure about something I did, I’d appreciate it if you checked with me first.
feedback.explanation: “I’d appreciate”将希望对方做的事与感谢联系起来，语气比直接命令更委婉。

choices.text: I’m happy to take responsibility when I make a mistake, but this wasn’t mine.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m happy to take responsibility when I make a mistake, but this wasn’t mine.
feedback.explanation: “take responsibility”表示承担责任；谈工作问题时，可以据此明确谁负责哪一部分。

turns.text: Okay. Maybe I should’ve checked before saying anything.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方愿意先核实再发言，会怎么说？

choices.text: That’s all I’m asking.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s all I’m asking.
feedback.explanation: 直接交代自己当前的状态或安排，能让对方据此继续交流。

choices.text: Thanks. I’d appreciate that in the future.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. I’d appreciate that in the future.
feedback.explanation: “I’d appreciate”将希望对方做的事与感谢联系起来，语气比直接命令更委婉。

choices.text: Good. I just wanted us to be clear about it.

feedback.naturalExpression: Good. I just wanted us to be clear about it.
feedback.explanation: 先回应对方刚给的信息或建议，再接着说明自己的想法，让话题顺着当前内容继续。

scenarios.title: C｜拿出证据说明
scenarios.setting: 在“同事把错误推给自己”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“拿出证据说明”。

turns.text: I’m still pretty sure the file you sent was the wrong one.

turns.prompt: 你想提出用记录核实事实，会怎么说？

choices.text: I actually have the message here. Let me show you.

feedback.naturalExpression: I actually have the message here. Let me show you.
feedback.explanation: “Let me …”提出由自己来做下一步，能明确谁来采取行动。

choices.text: Let’s check the email rather than rely on memory.

feedback.naturalExpression: Let’s check the email rather than rely on memory.
feedback.explanation: “rather than”表示更倾向前面的选择，常用于说明取舍。

choices.text: I kept the original file and the message where I sent it.

feedback.naturalExpression: I kept the original file and the message where I sent it.
feedback.explanation: “original”指原件或原始版本；与复印件、修改版区分。

choices.text: We can look at the timestamps if you want.

feedback.naturalExpression: We can look at the timestamps if you want.
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

turns.prompt: 你想指出记录中的关键信息，会怎么说？

choices.text: Here—the updated file was sent at 3:42 on Tuesday.

feedback.naturalExpression: Here—the updated file was sent at 3:42 on Tuesday.
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

choices.text: You can see here that the attachment was version 4.2.

feedback.naturalExpression: You can see here that the attachment was version 4.2.
feedback.explanation: “version”指版本，说明具体版本能避免双方使用不同文件。

choices.text: And this message confirms that everyone received the update.

feedback.naturalExpression: And this message confirms that everyone received the update.
feedback.explanation: “confirms”表示证实或确认，适合用记录支持自己对事实的说明。

choices.text: The older file was opened the following morning, after I’d already sent the new one.

feedback.naturalExpression: The older file was opened the following morning, after I’d already sent the new one.
feedback.explanation: “already”强调事情已经发生或完成，适合核对进度与时间先后。

turns.text: Oh. You’re right. I didn’t see that message.

turns.prompt: 你想告诉服务员自己的餐饮选择，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay. Then I’d like this to be clarified with the team.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Then I’d like this to be clarified with the team.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: Thanks for checking. Could you correct what was said in the meeting?

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks for checking. Could you correct what was said in the meeting?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: That’s fine, but I don’t want people to leave with the impression that the mistake was mine.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s fine, but I don’t want people to leave with the impression that the mistake was mine.
feedback.explanation: 明确表示接受刚提出的方案，让对方知道可以按这个安排继续。

turns.text: Yeah. I’ll clear it up with everyone.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thanks. I appreciate that.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. I appreciate that.
feedback.explanation: “I appreciate”表达对帮助、坦诚或付出的感谢，后面点明感谢对象更具体。

choices.text: Good. That’s important to me.

feedback.naturalExpression: Good. That’s important to me.
feedback.explanation: 先回应对方刚给的信息或建议，再接着说明自己的想法，让话题顺着当前内容继续。
